facts.fact: The Cabinet-approved AI in Education Framework establishes a National AI in Education Steering Committee that approves AI tools for schools, ensures compliance on ethics and data protection, and keeps approved and prohibited AI tool lists (State House).
facts.system: National AI in Education Steering Committee

facts.fact: The Ministry of Education is implementing two World Bank AI pilots: an AI Teacher Coach Programme for Primary 5 and 6 teachers in six schools and an AI Student Tutor Programme for Secondary 3 Mathematics and Geography in four schools (State House).
facts.system: AI Teacher Coach and AI Student Tutor pilots
